name: step-budget
context: Any autonomous loop (ReAct, LATS, agentic RAG) must be bounded: a per-request cap on tool calls, iterations, or tokens prevents runaway cost and infinite loops.
tradeoffs: Hard caps can truncate legitimate long tasks
use_cases: Cap ReAct at ten tool calls
avoid_when: Fixed budgets truncate mission-critical work without escalation
The task can be reliably completed within a fixed step count without risk
anti_patterns: Budgets only in prompts, never enforced in code
Flat per-turn token budget on accumulating context loops
Only checking budgets at end, not before each step
design_principles: Make the budget visible to the agent
best_practices: Warn at eighty percent of ANY predicate (step, time, cost, tool calls)
Check all predicates before every step, not after
Use tool+args hash for no-progress detection (3 repeats = stuck)
Apply per-tool quotas independent of global step cap
Use remaining_budget = min(remaining_budget, max_per_call) for wall-clock
references: Kim et al., An LLM Compiler for Parallel Function Calling, 2024 — https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.04511
Agent Patterns Catalog, Step Budget pattern — https://www.agentpatternscatalog.org/patterns/step-budget/
